about_short_description.short_description: Cohesive is a CRM company that provides automated lead generation and marketing platform solutions for local businesses.

product.name: Google Maps Scraper
product.description: A tool that automatically extracts local business data and owner emails from Google Maps for lead generation purposes.

product.name: Automated Email Campaigns
product.description: A system that creates, personalizes, and manages cold email outreach campaigns targeting local business leads.

product.name: Cohesive Google Sheets Extension
product.description: A Google Sheets add-on that enables users to perform AI-powered lead enrichment, web scraping, and contact discovery within spreadsheets.

product.name: Done-For-You Lead Generation Service
product.description: A fully managed service that automates lead research, email personalization, and outreach campaigns for local businesses.
